mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Campus Guide: "When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card,
# reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top."
# M21 Cultivate's verified partition (B5b-search-one-other-shuffle): with a ONE_OF move among the
# Seq's steps the SEARCH designates the found card without moving it, REVEAL shows it, and the
# ONE_OF move (over the found set only, Executor._partition_step / selectors' search_found) puts
# it where the text says. Here the shuffle comes between, as printed: the library is shuffled and
# then the found card goes on top (Gutless Plunderer's move to Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP)). The found
# card is set aside in the text and shuffled in here before it moves; the library that results is
# the same (the card on top, the rest in a random order). Optional as a whole (Solemn Simulacrum's
# "you may search", B2b-etb-basic-land); "basic land card" is the compiler's FAnd(SUPERTYPE_EQ
# Basic, TYPE_EQ Land).
basic_land = FAnd(
    children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUPERTYPE_EQ, string_value='Basic'),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
    ),
)
TOP = Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU, position=ZonePosition.TOP)
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.SEARCH, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=basic_land,
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': TOP,
                }),
                A(Verb.REVEAL, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=1)}),
                A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)}),
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.ONE_OF,
                        filter=basic_land,
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': TOP,
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (OptionalEffect: SEARCH designates a basic land card, REVEAL it, SHUFFLE, the ONE_OF move puts it on top)

mapping.notes: No card of the 19 sets has 'then shuffle and put that card on top' parsed (Liliana Vess's -2 is unparsed). Written with M21 Cultivate's verified partition: with a ONE_OF move among the steps the SEARCH only designates the found card (Executor._partition_step), REVEAL shows it, the library is shuffled and the ONE_OF move (over the found set only) puts it on top (Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP), Gutless Plunderer's move). The text sets the card aside during the shuffle; here it is shuffled with the rest and then moved: the resulting library is the same (that card on top, the rest in a random order), and the search still sees the library before the shuffle. Optional as a whole (Solemn Simulacrum).
